9 Things You Can Do With AI That Used to Take Hours

Discover nine ways AI can save time on writing, video creation, research, coding, presentations, and repetitive tasks using practical AI tools.

By LokkeeVerse · 7 min read

9 Things You Can Do With AI That Used to Take Hours

Artificial intelligence is changing how people work, study, and create content. Tasks that once required hours of research, writing, editing, and planning can now be completed much faster with the right AI tools.

You don't need to be a programmer or a technology expert to benefit. Many AI websites let you describe what you want in ordinary language and help you get started within minutes.

From creating videos to analyzing documents and building websites, here are nine practical things you can do with AI in 2026.

1. Turn Simple Ideas Into Full Articles

Writing a quality article from scratch can take hours. You need to research the topic, organize your ideas, create headings, write paragraphs, and edit everything before publishing.

AI writing assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude can help speed up this process.

You can provide a topic and ask for an outline, introduction, key points, and a first draft. You can then improve the result by adding examples, checking facts, and adjusting the writing to suit your audience.

For example, a blogger writing about personal finance could use AI to organize an article about saving money into clear sections before adding original insights and reliable sources.

Useful tools:

  • ChatGPT — https://chatgpt.com/
  • Claude — https://claude.ai/

2. Create Videos From Text Prompts

Video production often involves scripting, finding footage, editing clips, and adding visual effects. AI video generators can reduce some of that work by generating short clips from text prompts or reference images.

Tools such as Runway can help creators explore visual concepts without filming every scene themselves.

You could describe a futuristic city at night, a product advertisement, or a cinematic landscape and use the generated footage as part of a larger video.

AI-generated clips may still require editing, sound design, transitions, and fact-checking, particularly when a video depicts real events.

Useful tools:

  • Runway — https://runwayml.com/
  • Adobe Firefly — https://firefly.adobe.com/

3. Generate Images Without Professional Design Skills

Creating attractive images traditionally requires design software, technical knowledge, and time to refine every detail. AI image generators allow you to begin with a written description instead.

You can describe the subject, lighting, background, composition, and style you want. The tool generates an image that you can review and refine.

Content creators can use these tools to develop thumbnail concepts, illustrations, promotional graphics, and visual ideas for articles.

However, generated images can contain mistakes, so always inspect the result before publishing it.

Useful tools:

  • Leonardo AI — https://leonardo.ai/
  • Adobe Firefly — https://firefly.adobe.com/

4. Summarize Long Documents in Minutes

Imagine having a 70-page report to understand before a meeting or dozens of lecture pages to revise before an examination.

Reading every page carefully may take considerable time. AI document assistants can help you identify important points, summarize sections, and ask questions about the material.

NotebookLM, for example, lets you work with sources you provide and explore their contents through questions and summaries.

You could ask it to explain a difficult concept in simple language, identify the main arguments in a report, or create revision questions from your notes.

Always verify important details against the original document, especially when accuracy matters.

Useful tool:

  • NotebookLM — https://notebooklm.google.com/

5. Research Topics Faster

Research can involve opening numerous websites, comparing claims, checking sources, and organizing information into a useful summary.

AI-powered research tools can help you find relevant information and identify sources worth investigating.

Perplexity, for example, provides answers with links to sources, making it easier to follow up on claims and explore a topic further.

You can use it to investigate new technologies, compare products, research competitors, or gather background information before writing an article.

The important part is not accepting every answer as fact. Check the original sources, publication dates, and supporting evidence before using the information.

Useful tool:

  • Perplexity — https://www.perplexity.ai/

6. Turn Your Voice Into Written Content

Sometimes speaking is much faster than typing, especially when you already know what you want to say.

AI-assisted voice tools can convert spoken words into text and help clean up dictated writing. This can be useful when drafting messages, capturing ideas, or preparing a rough article.

For example, a freelancer could dictate the first version of an email, then review and edit it instead of composing every sentence manually.

Voice recognition is not perfect. Names, accents, technical terms, and punctuation can cause errors, so review important messages before sending them.

Useful tools:

  • Wispr Flow — https://wisprflow.ai/
  • Otter.ai — https://otter.ai/

7. Build Websites With AI Assistance

Building a website used to require substantial time spent writing code, designing layouts, fixing errors, and testing different screen sizes.

AI coding assistants can now help developers generate code, understand error messages, and improve existing projects.

For instance, you could ask an AI assistant to explain why a React component is not rendering properly or help create a responsive navigation menu.

These tools are particularly useful for beginners because they can explain code as well as suggest changes. However, generated code is not guaranteed to work correctly or securely.

Test the result, understand important changes, and avoid pasting sensitive information into tools without checking their privacy practices.

Useful tools:

  • GitHub Copilot — https://github.com/features/copilot
  • Cursor — https://cursor.com/

8. Create Presentations From an Outline

Preparing a presentation can involve organizing research, writing slide content, selecting layouts, and finding suitable visuals.

AI presentation tools can help turn an outline or a written document into an initial slide structure. You can then adjust the design, add supporting evidence, and remove unnecessary information.

A student preparing a class presentation could start with a topic, generate an outline, and refine the slides rather than designing every page from a blank canvas.

For business presentations, always check financial figures, claims, and recommendations before presenting them to clients or colleagues.

Useful tools:

  • Gamma — https://gamma.app/
  • Canva — https://www.canva.com/

9. Automate Repetitive Tasks

Some of the most valuable uses of AI involve reducing repetitive work rather than generating content.

Automation platforms can connect compatible apps so that an action in one service triggers another. For example, a new form submission could create a record in a spreadsheet and send a notification to the relevant person.

Zapier can help users build these workflows with limited manual intervention. More advanced workflows may require careful configuration and testing.

Businesses can use automation to manage leads, organize notifications, route customer enquiries, and reduce repetitive administrative work.

Start with a low-risk task, test different scenarios, and monitor the workflow to make sure it behaves as expected.

Useful tool:

  • Zapier — https://zapier.com/

How to Get Better Results From AI

Having access to AI tools does not automatically make you productive. The quality of your instructions and the way you review the results matter.

Use these simple practices:

  • Be specific about the result you want.
  • Provide relevant background information.
  • Ask the AI to organize complex tasks into smaller steps.
  • Review facts, calculations, and generated content.
  • Protect confidential and personal information.
  • Test AI-generated code and automated workflows before relying on them.
  • Keep using tools that genuinely save time instead of signing up for every new platform.

AI can speed up parts of a task, but the actual time saved depends on its complexity, your experience, and how much editing is needed.

Final Thoughts

AI is becoming useful far beyond answering questions. It can help people write articles, generate visual content, summarize documents, research topics, build websites, create presentations, and automate repetitive work.

You do not need to master every tool at once. Choose one task that regularly takes too much of your time and experiment with an AI tool designed to help with it.

The goal is not to let AI make every decision for you. It is to reduce unnecessary work so you can spend more time on creativity, learning, and decisions that require human judgment.
